module_summary: 1G Ethernet MAC with GMII PHY interface: wraps an AXI-stream MAC and GMII I/O block, plus a speed detector counting RX clock edges against gtx_clk to pick 10/100/1000 and MII mode.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Transmit AXI-stream payload into the MAC.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid for transmit AXI-stream input.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tready
anchors.why: MAC ready backpressuring the transmit stream.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received frame payload output from the MAC.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid for received AXI-stream output.

anchors.name: gmii_rxd
anchors.why: PHY GMII receive data into the PHY interface block.

anchors.name: gmii_txd
anchors.why: GMII transmit data driven to the PHY.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_rxd
anchors.why: Registered GMII receive data from PHY interface to MAC.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_txd
anchors.why: MAC transmit GMII data to the PHY interface block.

anchors.name: mii_select_reg
anchors.why: Selects MII vs GMII mode for PHY interface clocking and MAC.

anchors.name: speed_reg
anchors.why: Detected link speed code driving speed output.

anchors.name: rx_speed_count_1
anchors.why: Reference gtx_clk counter; overflow means 10M, high bits distinguish 100M.

anchors.name: rx_speed_count_2
anchors.why: Counts prescaled RX clock edges; overflow triggers speed decision.

anchors.name: rx_prescale
anchors.why: RX-clock prescaler whose MSB is synchronized for speed detection.

anchors.name: rx_prescale_sync
anchors.why: Synchronizer of prescaled RX clock into gtx_clk; edge increments count_2.

anchors.name: tx_mii_select_sync
anchors.why: mii_select synchronized into tx_clk for MAC TX.

anchors.name: tx_error_underflow
anchors.why: MAC transmit underflow status.

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_frame
anchors.why: MAC received bad frame status.

anchors.name: cfg_ifg
anchors.why: Inter-frame gap configuration for MAC transmitter.

anchors.name: cfg_tx_enable
anchors.why: Enables MAC transmit.

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Enables MAC receive.

groups.name: mac
groups.description: 1G MAC converting AXI-stream to/from GMII with config and error status.

groups.name: gmii_phy_if
groups.description: GMII I/O registers and clock mux between MAC and PHY.

groups.name: speed_detect
groups.description: Compares RX clock rate against gtx_clk to set speed and mii_select.
